Armed Assault Wiki, AMV-7_Marshall, ARMA 3 Trivia (wikitext section 44): "* The Marshall is based on the real-world "Armored Modular Vehicle" designed by Patria of Finland. ** More specifically, it is based on the "Badger" IFV, a locally manufactured variant of the AMV designed by Denel SOC Ltd of South Africa. The Badger combines the AMV's chassis with that of Denel's "Modular Combat Turret" (MCT), though the real Badger uses a 30 mm autocannon as opposed to the Marshall's 40 mm." Citation: https://armedassault.fandom.com/wiki/AMV-7_Marshall. The page asserts the basis twice: the Marshall 'is based on the real-world "Armored Modular Vehicle" designed by Patria of Finland', and 'more specifically, it is based on the "Badger" IFV, a locally manufactured variant of the AMV designed by Denel SOC Ltd of South Africa'. The corpus holds the Patria AMV and not the Badger variant, so the binding names the base vehicle and the evidence names the variant. The Badger variant is recorded as a missing capture in data/vehicle/RESEARCH_GAPS.md. The binding is graded claimed because the source is a tier-5 community compilation (data/vehicle/SCHEMA.md sections 3, 7 and 8).
